_about: Hand-kept part of breeds/breeds.json (tools/build-breeds.js). wikidata: FCI number -> Wikidata item where automatic matching fails. names: per id, names that beat Wikidata and the Raad van Beheer. aliases: extra search terms (typos, local names). rvb: Raad van Beheer name -> id (null = not used). varieties: FCI varieties worth picking on their own. extra: crosses (x-), breeds outside the FCI (nf-), mixed, other. popular: the order shown before searching (common in Europe).
